Who We Are:

Headquartered in New York City, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a leading developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. We develop and publish products principally through Rockstar Games, 2K, and Zynga. Our strategy is to create hit entertainment experiences, delivered on every platform relevant to our audience through a variety of sound business models. Our pillars - creativity, innovation, and efficiency - guide us as we strive to create the highest quality, most captivating experiences for our consumers. The Company’s common stock is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol TTWO. For more corporate and product information please visit our website at http://www.take2games.com.

While our offices (physical and virtual) are casual and inviting, we are deeply committed to our core tenets of creativity, innovation and efficiency, and individual and team development opportunities. Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.

The Challenge:

The selected candidate will be responsible for business affairs legal work for a dynamic entertainment company and will work closely with internal business clients and senior in-house counsel. This position will negotiate, draft, and track a high-volume of legal agreements relating to entertainment, technology, advertising, intellectual property and related matters. This position is an in-person role based in our London office. This role will focus on the mobile games industry working with colleagues across EMEA, the US and the world, and the selected candidate should be commercially minded and pragmatic.

What You’ll Take On:

•

Draft, analyze and negotiate commercial agreements for all aspects of entertainment content creation, production, marketing and distribution.

•

Advise our internal teams that focus on game development, engineering, mobile platforms and app stores, user acquisition, ad tech, monetization, IP licensing and product distribution.

•

Bring expertise to a wide range of commercial agreements applicable to mobile gaming (such as MSAs, Monetization Agreements, IOs, and DPAs) including AdTech and MarTech vendors, analytics and attribution service providers, outsourcing and software vendors.

•

Independently handle contract negotiations with a pragmatic orientation and with multi-jurisdictional awareness. Partner with our business clients to meet commercial goals.

•

Structure and analyze deals within a matrix of rights held by third parties, such as content distributors, hardware manufacturers, sports leagues, record labels, music publishers, actors and other talent, technology licensors, software developers, entertainment companies, advertising agencies, ancillary merchandise vendors, data analytics providers, information technology vendors and similar entities.

•

Advise internal clients regarding general business and contract issues, as well as copyright, technology, corporate, regulatory and related matters.

•

Provide day-to-day legal and business affairs counsel to highly creative business units.

•

Assess risks associated with highly complex legal issues in a fast-paced environment.

•

Serve as part of the Legal team helping Take-Two’s publishing labels create the most innovative and creative products in the most efficient way possible.

What You Bring:

•

3+ years of post-qualification experience in-house or within a law firm.

•

Expertise in contracting issues, with excellent drafting skills.

•

Experience with complex corporate or intellectual property transactions, including content creation, production, clearance, marketing and distribution.

•

Experience with software and technology licensing and development.

•

Experience with entertainment or technology matters, or significant corporate experience with a strong desire to transition to entertainment and technology matters.

•

Must have the ability and desire to evaluate and advise on complex agreements and contractual issues, and effectively distill information for clients.

•

Must possess common sense, patience, good humor, and a commitment to teamwork.

•

Strong communication skills; ability to convey complex matters in clear terms to clients and colleagues.

•

Enthusiasm for the videogame industry.

•

Eagerness to embrace AI and other new technologies in the legal practice.

•

Remains calm and confident despite deadlines and challenging priorities.

•

Qualified and in good standing as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales, or relevant jurisdiction.

What We Offer You:

• Great Company Culture. We pride ourselves as being one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
• Growth: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
• Work Hard, Play Hard. Our employees’ bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, our onsite Gym, company parties, our Office bar, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.
• Benefits. Include, but aren't limited to, private medical and dental insurance, virtual GP, a health cash plan for preventative medical costs, matching pension policy up to 4%, a workplace savings scheme for short-term savings, £50 monthly fitness reimbursement, 24/7 mental wellbeing support, family building and menopause support, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan with 15% discount, Cycle to Work scheme, 4x salary death in service insurance, 66% of salary income protection, charitable donation matching and volunteer leave, 26 days of annual leave, and enhanced family policies.
• Perks. Onsite Gym, an office bar, employee discount programs, free games and events, stocked pantries, and a dog friendly workplace.

Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Role Overview
Coupang is seeking a Director, Inventory Allocation and Control to lead a critical horizontal planning function that connects Retail growth, fulfillment operations, inventory governance, inbound planning, capacity management, and customer availability.

This leader will own end-to-end inventory planning policy and execution governance, including Days of Cover management, inbound planning, ordering controls, capacity alignment, peak event readiness, business review mechanisms, and planning automation. The role requires a senior planning leader who can make high-quality tradeoff decisions across growth, availability, capacity, working capital, and margin, while keeping customer experience at the center.

The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in retail planning, supply chain planning, S&OP, inventory management, or operations planning. They should be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, data-driven environment, influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders, and building scalable mechanisms that reduce manual work and improve planning quality. E-commerce experience is preferred but not required. Korean language ability is a plus.

What You Will Do
• Own end-to-end inventory planning policy, governance, and execution across short, medium, and long-term planning horizons.
• Lead DOC management, inbound planning, capacity alignment, ordering governance, and replenishment control mechanisms.
• Balance commercial growth, customer availability, fulfillment capacity, working capital, and margin outcomes through clear planning decisions.
• Partner cross-functionally to identify risks, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure inventory and inbound plans are operationally executable.
• Lead planning for major seasonal and holiday events, including buildup strategy, capacity readiness, vendor execution, and post-event learnings.
• Improve inbound planning accuracy, ordering discipline, and visibility into future operational constraints and availability risks.
• Build scalable mechanisms, dashboards, agents, and workflows that reduce manual work and improve planning quality.
• Own planning inputs for business reviews, annual planning, goal-setting, and executive-level operating discussions.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for horizontal inventory planning and inbound planning.
• Drive a culture of analytical decision-making, ownership, simplification, and cross-functional accountability.

• 5+ years of people leadership experience, including managing senior managers, managers, or senior individual contributors
• Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, inbound planning, capacity planning, and demand-supply tradeoffs
• Demonstrated ability to balance business growth, customer experience, operational constraints, and financial outcomes
• Proven ability to operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous, data-driven environment and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders
• Strong analytical judgment, business communication, and executive-level narrative-building skills
• Ability to build scalable mechanisms and improve operating processes, not just manage recurring execution

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in e-commerce, retail, marketplace, consumer goods, logistics, distribution, or high-volume supply chain environments
• Experience working at the intersection of commercial teams and operations teams where availability, capacity, cost, and growth tradeoffs must be managed
• Experience leading S&OP, inventory control, inbound planning, ordering governance, or capacity management functions
• Experience building planning automation, control towers, dashboards, decision-support systems, or agent-based workflows

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're looking for a BDR Enablement Lead to own the curriculum and craft development of Anthropic's business development organization.

Our BDRs are the front door to the pipeline and, for many of them, this is the first serious sales role of their career. What they learn here shapes how they sell for the next decade. This role owns that formation: the onboarding curriculum, sales foundations, the ongoing skill development, and the pipeline generation playbooks that turn effort into meetings.

It is also a role with an unusual opportunity. Anthropic's BDRs should be the most AI-native prospecting team in the industry. You will build the workflows that make that true — using plugins, account research skills, and agentic tooling to change what a BDR can accomplish in a day. Doing this well requires someone who is genuinely excited about the craft of prospecting and about rebuilding it around what AI now makes possible.

Key responsibilities

• Own the BDR onboarding curriculum, taking new hires from day one to first meeting booked as quickly as we responsibly can
• Enable BDRs on AI-native prospecting workflows, including plugins, account research skills, and agentic tooling that meaningfully change BDR productivity
• Develop and maintain pipeline generation playbooks across segments, personas, and motions
• Run ongoing skill development on sales fundamentals: cold calling, written outreach, objection handling, discovery, and qualification
• Certify BDRs on our products, our qualification criteria, and our messaging
• Partner with BDR leadership to identify where skill gaps are constraining pipeline, and build focused interventions
• Build the coaching and call-review infrastructure that gives BDRs specific, frequent feedback
• Measure enablement impact on ramp time, activity quality, meeting conversion, and pipeline contribution
• Create a clear development path from BDR into the next role, in partnership with sales leadership

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in Enablement, including time as a high-performing BDR or BDR manager
• Have excelled in the role you are now enabling, and are passionate about mentorship and early-career development
• Are excited about rebuilding the prospecting motion around AI rather than bolting AI onto the old one
• Are hands-on with prospecting tooling and willing to build workflows yourself rather than specifying them for someone else
• Can teach the unglamorous fundamentals with energy, and can model them on a live call
• Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy building from 0 to 1
• Care about the person as much as the number, and can hold both
• Are technically curious about AI and credible talking about our products with a technical audience

Preferred qualifications

• Have 8+ years of experience in Enablement, including time as a high-performing BDR or BDR manager
• Hand-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and other Claude surfaces
• Experience collaborating across global and cross-functional teams
• Experience building 0-1 onboarding programs and discovery frameworks
• Experience designing or operating a BDR-to-AE promotion path
• Hands-on experience building prospecting automations, agents, or internal tooling
• Experience enabling BDRs across multiple segments or regions
• A track record connecting BDR enablement to measurable pipeline outcomes

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$270,000—$310,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're making our first CRO hire to own conversion at Suno, across web and the app stores. You'll sit on the Growth team at the point where our marketing spend turns into revenue: the landing pages, app store listings, funnels, and copy people hit after they click an ad, land from search, or find us in the App Store.

This is a performance job. You'll live in the numbers – conversion rate, install rate, CAC, revenue per visitor – and tie every test you run back to what it did for the business. You'll own the strategy and the copy, build pages and listings from our existing design system, and ship experiments at a pace that surprises people. You'll understand our ideal customer better than anyone in the building – who they are, what brings them to Suno, and what makes them convert — and shape every page, listing, and test around that.

You'll partner with User Acquisition, Lifecycle, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, and you'll work within our existing design system rather than in Figma yourself — grab a template, own the copy and the test, and ship. Conversion is yours to run. This is a senior IC role with real ownership and no team to manage. We want a hacker: someone scrappy and relentless who finds the fast path, ships more tests than anyone thinks is possible, and cares about learning fast and at scale more than about building the perfect system.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/vVeA30cOueLXfw8R

- Understand our ideal customer more deeply than anyone else here, and turn that into pages, listings, copy, and tests that actually speak to them

- Ship a high volume of landing pages across paid, SEO, lifecycle, partnerships, and new launches, assembled from our existing design system and tailored to the channel and audience each serves

- Own app store optimization: the listing copy, screenshots, and store creative that turn store visits into installs, and the handoff into onboarding

- Localize and adapt pages and store listings for our international markets, so conversion holds up across languages and regions

- Run experiments at real volume: A/B and multivariate tests shipped quickly, using AI and whatever scrappy tooling gets you more shots on goal than the team could hit by hand

- Dig into user behavior with heatmaps, session recordings, surveys, and analytics to find where people drop off and why

- Hunt down the highest-leverage opportunities across the funnel by combining performance data, user research, and business context

- Own the conversion numbers end to end across web and app: conversion rate, install rate, CAC, and revenue per visitor, paid and organic

- Partner with Revenue Product on paywall and upsell copy, keeping it clear and true to what people are getting

- Push conversion testing to a volume and speed Suno hasn't seen, and pull the rest of the company along with what you learn

About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

In this role, you will:

- Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

- Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

- Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.

- Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.

- Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.

- Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.

- Partner with Go-to-Market and Technical Success teams to understand the business importance of customer workloads and ensure that relevant commercial context informs severity, prioritization, and communication without bypassing established support processes.

- Represent Support Engineering in relevant customer meetings, including QBRs, and partner closely with account teams to communicate technical health, surface risks and blockers early, coordinate follow-up, and provide customers and internal stakeholders with clear, proactive updates.

- Monitor customer integrations and support trends to identify emerging risks, recurring failure patterns, and readiness gaps before they become major escalations.

- Prepare for important launches, migrations, traffic increases, and business events by developing account-specific runbooks, validating escalation paths, coordinating support readiness, and providing heightened monitoring where needed.

- Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.

- Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.

- Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.

- Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands-on diagnosis of complex production issues.

- Have expert-level troubleshooting skills and a strong track record of resolving ambiguous technical problems across APIs, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations.

- Are comfortable working with logs, metrics, traces, API requests, authentication flows, and customer-provided code or configurations to understand system behavior and test hypotheses.

- Have experience leading or playing a central role in customer-impacting incidents, including severity assessment, technical coordination, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, and post-incident follow-through.

- Can write code or scripts to reproduce issues, interrogate systems, automate repetitive work, and improve internal tools. Experience with Python, JavaScript, or similar languages is valuable.

- Can communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders—especially when information is incomplete or evolving.

- Build strong, high-trust relationships with customers and cross-functional partners while maintaining clear and scalable ownership boundaries.

- Look beyond the immediate issue to identify patterns, improve the system, and prevent the same problem from recurring.

- Thrive in ambiguity, update quickly as new information emerges, and are willing to learn whatever is needed to get the job done.

- Bring a humble, team-first mindset, strong judgment, and a genuine eagerness to help both customers and colleagues succeed.

- Are excited to use OpenAI’s products, agents, and emerging AI capabilities to transform how technical support operates at scale.

jobs.description: Job Description Specialist, Data Stewardship The Opportunity: Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives. This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office. Role Overview: The Specialist, Data Stewardship role plays a pivotal part in the creation, maintenance, accuracy, and compliant execution of master data supporting our company Manufacturing and Supply Chain operations, directly supporting business outcomes and ultimately impacting patients who rely on life-saving products. This is a global role supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain master data processes. The Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely execution of master data creation, extension, update, and maintenance requests. The role works closely with Data Steward Leads, ISO Stewards, Supply Chain stakeholders, and other relevant partners to ensure master data is established and maintained in accordance with global SOPs, work instructions, data standards, and business requirements. What will you do in this role Master Data Creation and Maintenance Execute master data creation, extension, update, and maintenance activities supporting Manufacturing and Supply Chain processes. Perform first-time material code creation, changes, and extensions, including required pre-checks and validation activities. Evaluate the appropriate parameters and data sets required to execute compliant and error-free master data changes within SAP ECC and SAP S/4. Proactive and solution-oriented mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand master data dependencies and the downstream impact of data changes. Strong stakeholder collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel. Understanding of GxP principles and controlled working practices. [회사소개]
쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠(coupang eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다. 분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.
[팀 소개]
Merchant Engineering 팀은 한국 쿠팡이츠뿐만 아니라 글로벌 서비스(일반 로켓나우 등) 전반에 걸친 엔드투엔드(End-to-End) 상점주 여정(Merchant Journey)을 구축하고 혁신합니다. 우리는 상점주에게 필요한 시스템을 제공하여 지역 상점주들이 온라인 배달 모델에 쉽게 적응하고 성공적인 온라인 비즈니스를 운영할 수 있도록 지원합니다.
우리 팀은 입점(Onboarding), 메뉴 관리, 주문 처리, 정산, 매출 분석에 이르기까지 수십만 상점주가 비즈니스를 원활하게 운영할 수 있도록 돕는 핵심 플랫폼을 담당합니다. 상점주 및 고객이 위탁한 데이터의 주요 시스템을 소유하며, 고객은 정확한 매장 및 메뉴 정보를 바탕으로 최적의 선택을 하게 됩니다. 글로벌 비즈니스 확장과 빠르게 변화하는 커머스 환경 속에서, 우리는 주요 사업 관계자들과 긴밀히 협력하여 최상의 상점주 경험을 제공하고 있습니다. 동적이고 활력 있는 환경 속에서 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력을 발휘하며 함께 성장할 리더를 찾고 있습니다.
본 직무는 쿠팡 본사(Coupang Corp.) 소속 채용 건입니다.
주요 업무 (Key Responsibilities)
상점주 기술 전략 수립 및 실행:
한국 및 글로벌 상점주 플랫폼의 제품, 운영, 규제 요구사항을 실행 가능한 기술 로드맵으로 전환하고 이행을 주도합니다.
핵심 상점주 도메인 관리:
매장 입점, 메뉴/가격 관리, 주문 수락/상태 관리, 정산/매출 분석을 포함한 상점주 도메인 전반의 소프트웨어 개발 생애주기(설계, 개발, 테스트, 배포, 운영)를 총괄합니다.
아키텍처 리더십 및 시스템 안정성:
주요 기술 결정을 주도하고, 대규모 상점주 데이터를 안정적으로 처리할 수 있는 고가용성·고성능 백엔드 아키텍처를 설계합니다.
엔지니어링 우수성(Engineering Excellence):
코드 품질, 성능, 보안 기준을 수립하고 인시던트 관리, 온콜(On-call) 로테이션, 포스트모템(Post-mortem) 프로세스의 지속적인 개선을 이끕니다.
프로젝트 및 리소스 관리:
병렬로 진행되는 여러 프로젝트의 일정, 리소스, 리스크, 우선순위를 관리합니다.
팀 리더십 및 인재 육성:
백엔드 엔지니어의 채용, 코칭, 평가 및 커리어 성장을 지원하여 고성능 엔지니어링 조직을 구축합니다.
크로스 파트너십/협업:
프로덕트, 운영, 법무 및 글로벌 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 요구사항을 조율하고 최선의 의사결정을 내립니다.
프로세스 및 생산성 혁신:
AI 기반 환경을 포함한 현대적 개발 방식 도입을 통해 팀의 엔지니어링 생산성과 시스템 운영 워크플로우를 구조적으로 개선합니다.
자격 요건 (Minimum Qualifications)
8년 이상의 백엔드 개발 경험 및 백엔드 엔지니어링 매니저 또는 테크 리드(Tech Lead)로서 입증된 리더십 경험
고트래픽 환경에서 대용량 분산 시스템 설계 및 마이크로서비스 아키텍처(MSA) 운영 경험 (성능, 안정성, 데이터 정합성, 보안 고려 필수)
복잡한 비즈니스 도메인(예: 매장, 정산, 상품/메뉴 관리 등)의 오너십을 갖고 시스템을 지속적으로 개선해 본 경험
운영 인시던트 대응, 모니터링 프레임워크 구축, 온콜 로테이션 관리를 포함한 서비스 SLA 유지 경험
복잡한 비즈니스 문제를 명확한 기술적 솔루션으로 전환할 수 있는 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력
글로벌 이해관계자 및 해외 엔지니어링 팀과의 원활한 협업을 위한 비즈니스 수준의 영어 소통 능력
우대 사항 (Preferred Qualifications)
Java 및 Spring Framework를 활용한 대규모 서비스 개발 및 운영 경험
다국어/다국가 서비스 운영 경험, 국가별 정산/세무 규제 대응 및 로컬라이제이션 주도 경험
B2B SaaS, 이커머스 상점주 플랫폼, 머천트 포털, 정산/결제 도메인 구축 경험
이벤트 기반 아키텍처(Event-Driven Architecture), 메시지 큐(Kafka 등), JPA/RDBMS/NoSQL 최적화 경험
조직 전체 및 인접 팀에 강력한 영향력을 미칠 수 있는 기술적 리더십
엔지니어링 품질 표준, 코드 리뷰 문화, 전반적인 개발 프로세스를 한 단계 끌어올린 경험
전형 절차
서류전형 - 리크루터 스크리닝콜 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
전형 절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다. 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고 사항

Company Description
CES (Coupang Eats Services) manages dedicated delivery partner operations and service teams that support customers, store owners, and delivery partners. We wow our customers by delivering what they want, when and where they want it. We also provide OSS (One-Stop Service) to help our restaurant partners connect with hungry customers by solving all types of problems related to our EDP (Eats Delivery Partners). If you are interested in redefining the future of food delivery, join us. With Coupang’s innovative technology, Coupang Eats Services will continue to offer delicious food to customers, empower local businesses, and generate new ways for delivery partners to earn, work, and live.
Team Description
The Merchant Engineering team is responsible for building and innovating the end-to-end Merchant Journey for Coupang Eats in Korea as well as global services (such as Rocket Now in Japan). We empower merchants and help potential local merchants to adapt to the online delivery model and support them to run successful online businesses.
Our team owns the core platform that enables hundreds of thousands of merchants to run their businesses smoothly—from onboarding and menu management to order processing, settlements, and sales analytics. Our team owns the key systems for the entrusted data from merchants and our customers rely on accurate store and menu information to choose the best to their needs. In an expanding global business and fast-changing commerce environment, we work closely with key business stakeholders to deliver the best possible merchant experience.
We are looking for a leader who can demonstrate exceptional problem-solving skills and grow within this dynamic environment.
This position is employed under Coupang Corp. (Headquarters).
Key Responsibilities
Merchant Technical Strategy & Execution:
Translate product, operational, and regulatory requirements across Korea and global merchant platforms into an actionable technical roadmap and drive execution.
Core Merchant Domain Management:
Oversee the full software development lifecycle (design, development, testing, deployment, and operations) across the merchant domain, including store onboarding, menu/pricing management, order acceptance/status management, and settlement/sales analytics.
Architecture Leadership & System Stability:
Lead key technical decisions and design high-availability, high-performance backend architectures capable of handling merchant data.
Engineering Excellence:
Establish standards for code quality, performance, and security. Drive continuous improvement in incident management, on-call rotations, and post-mortem processes.
Project & Resource Management:
Manage schedules, resources, risks, and task priorities across multiple parallel projects.
Team Leadership & Talent Development:
Build a high-performing engineering organization by recruiting, coaching, evaluating, and supporting the career growth of backend engineers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner closely with Product, Operations, Legal, and global teams to align on requirements and make optimal trade-off decisions.
Process & Productivity Innovation:
Structurally improve team engineering productivity and system operational workflows by adopting modern development practices, including AI-driven environments.
Minimum Qualifications
8+ years of backend development experience, with proven leadership experience as a Backend Engineering Manager or Tech Lead.
Proven track record of designing distributed systems and operating Microservice Architectures (MSA) in high-traffic environments, with strong consideration for performance, stability, data consistency, and security.
Experience taking ownership of complex business domains (e.g., stores, settlements, product/menu management) and driving continuous system improvements.
Experience maintaining service SLAs, including production incident response, building monitoring frameworks, and managing on-call rotations.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business problems into clear technical solutions.
Professional English communication skills for seamless collaboration with global stakeholders and international engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
Extensive experience developing and operating large-scale services using Java and the Spring Framework.
Experience operating multi-country services, accommodating country-specific settlement/tax regulations, and leading localization efforts.
Background in building B2B SaaS, e-Commerce Merchant Platforms, Merchant Portal, or settlement/payment domains.
Deep experience with Event-Driven Architectures, message queues (e.g., Kafka), and JPA/RDBMS/NoSQL optimization.
